removed_padding: Fully transparent pixels outside the alpha bounding box only.
unit_resampling: Pillow NEAREST; proportional fit; no color interpolation.
background: Built-in imagegen; environment only; resized to canvas with Pillow LANCZOS.
verification_method: Reopen the final PNG; compare RGB at every scaled-source alpha=255 pixel. Independently map those pixels to original WebP coordinates using nearest-neighbor sample centers and compare RGB byte-for-byte. Hash the source before and after. The source is downsampled to fit; not every full-resolution source pixel appears.
